sources.observation: Official RFP sought a Dubai-campus website with alumni access, CMS and English/Arabic content. It required SAP/Moodle/payment integrations, chatbot, migration and audit. Proposal mailbox dubairfq@iima.ac.in was scoped to that expired RFP.

Official Tender Board search excerpt describes website replacement with IGA and UN accessibility/digital-service criteria. Full-page retrieval failed twice; deadline, submission route and detailed scope remain unverified.

Official 2026 procurement index includes enterprise/customer-service/e-services projects and directs bidders to Etimad. No specific bounded Nexora website/portal opportunity or email invitation was verified.

excludedSearchCategories: Generic agency or software-vendor sales pages are not evidence about a named prospect's manual records or demand.
Expired procurement advertisements and completed freelance projects do not authorise a new pitch.
Supplier registration and tender portals are not blanket email marketing permission.
